def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first').reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Fix island label variants
    df['island'] = df['island'].replace({'Bisco': 'Biscoe', 'Dram': 'Dream'})
    
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'gentoo': 'Gentoo', 'adelie': 'Adelie'})
    
    # Fix negative flipper_length_mm (take absolute value)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    counts = df['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
    return counts
